In the depths of the Korvatunturi mountains, 486 meters deep, lies the closest ever guarded secret of Christmas. The time has come to dig it up. This Christmas, everyone will believe in Santa Claus. European horror often brings a unique sense of mayhem with it, as does the holiday season. Rare Exports leans into this, bringing a very fun offbeat blizzard of strangeness to the big screen. Thankfully, Baron Von Terror will be on hand to help unpack this gift of a movie throughout the evening.

description_paragraphs: Before RRR took the world by storm, master filmmaker S.S. Rajamouli redefined Indian Cinema with his Bāhubali saga. The epic tale of royalty, revenge, kings, and battles comes to screens with a fully remastered picture and sound, plus a few new surprises for the big screen. When a lost prince is rescued and raised in exile, he grows up unaware of his past. Years later, he returns to uncover the truth about his father's murder and his mother's imprisonment, and must rise to reclaim his place as the rightful king. Part of Epic Movie Week at Central Cinema

The two soon find themselves caught up in an ongoing battle between good and evil taking place both in and beneath the streets of San Francisco's Chinatown.

description_paragraphs:
Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman star as Rick and Ilsa, two ex-lovers brought back together by fate in Nazi occupied Casablanca. Ilsa's new husband needs out of the country to continue his efforts against the Third Reich, and American ex-pat Rick may be the only one who can aid their escape. And while he's reluctant to risk his nightclub and his life, he's even more torn over the possibility of losing the only woman he's ever truly loved for a second time.
Consistently named one of the finest films ever made, Casablanca lives up to its reputation with its romantic tale fused with tension and humor.

description_paragraphs: Do you love movies and want to find others who can talk endlessly about them? Come join Cinemancy! Each month, a new movie is carefully selected. After the film the audience gathers to discuss themes, characters, plot, and symbolism. Hosted by Isabella Price. THE GREEN KNIGHT A holiday movie through and through. The Green Knight takes place on two days: Christmas, and one year later also on Christmas. Can't beat that. You know what else is hard to beat? The Green Knight. He shows up to King Arthur's court and asks who will play a Christmas game. The rules: one brave knight gets a free blow against the emerald skinned knight, and one year from that day, the knight may return the blow exactly as received. Sir Gawain, King Arthur's reckless and headstrong nephew, takes up the challenge and maybe goes a little too hard, with unexpected results. One year later, his actions lead him on a fantastical quest to confront his fate, whatever it may be. The film is exciting, with scrumptious visuals served throughout. A great A24 alternative holiday adventure worthy of the big screen. Doors at 6:30pm. Show starts at 7pm. Feel free to meet up in the lobby starting at 6pm with your fellow cinemancers. This event does not qualify for Tuesday two-for-one tickets

Maybe choose Kevin; not just because he's the nice one, but also because he's teamed up with a little girl who has a map to dry land tattooed on her back. There's tons of actions and amazing costumes to enjoy and/or riff on. Get wet and wild with Hollywood's reverse Mad Max. raw.calendar_title: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
description_paragraphs: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride, wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies. Tarantino always viewed Kill Bill as one movie, even when it was originally released in two parts and had various elements cut for time. The Whole Bloody Affair unifies the pieces into one revenge inspired by martial arts and samurai films from across the sea. Part of Epic Movie Week at Central Cinema.

description_paragraphs: This is one of those "this is a real movie?" movies that many have not seen. Made with all his heart and soul, Richard Kelly's follow up to Donnie Darko is a epic sci-fi satire with a stacked cast and a lot of fun energy. Set in the futuristic landscape of Los Angeles on July 4, 2008, as it stands on the brink of social, economic and environmental disaster. Boxer Santaros (Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson) is an action star who's stricken with amnesia. His life intertwines with Krysta Now, (Sarah Michelle Gellar) an adult film star developing her own reality television project, and Ronald Taverner (Sean William Scott), a Hermosa Beach police officer who holds the key to a vast conspiracy. The story is narrated by an unstable celebrety-turned-soldier played by Justin Timberlake. Taking aim at mid 2000's celebrity culture as well as the politics and tactics of the Bush Administration, the satire has only grown more relevant over the years. A blockade in The Straight ot Hormuz, weaponizing patriotism for political control, Dwayne Johnson as the most popular movie star, Southland Tales deals with all of this and more. Southland Tales is wild and weird. See it to believe it. This is the theatrical cut, which the director says he prefers for people to see the first time they watch Southland Tales. This title does no qualify for Tuesday two-for-one tickets

description_paragraphs: Tokyo Godfathers is a 2003 Christmas tragicomedy directed by Satoshi Kon. It tells the story of three homeless people; Gin, a middle-aged alcoholic and gambling addict; Hana, a transgender woman and former drag queen; and Miyuki, a runaway teenage girl. When they find a baby girl one Christmas Eve, the three take it upon themselves to return the baby to her parents, all the while slowly coming to confront past and present regrets. Satoshi Kon was inspired by the 1948 John Wayne film 3 Godfathers to make the film. Presented with the original Japanese soundtrack and English subtitles.

description_paragraphs: In a futuristic world where the polar ice caps have melted and made Earth a liquid planet, a beautiful barmaid rescues a mutant seafarer from a floating island prison. They escape, along with her young charge, Enola, and sail off aboard his ship. But the trio soon becomes the target of a menacing pirate who covets the map to 'Dryland'—which is tattooed on Enola's back. A classic '90s sci-fi blockbuster with lots of practical stunts and effects. Good times. Part of Epic Movie Week at Central Cinema. The 4pm show is the movie in its pure form. (This is the showing you are buying tickets for.) The 7pm show is in Hecklevision.
